_label: Assumes the March 2026 Basel III endgame proposal is adopted as proposed; LCR outflow applied conservatively to all unused card lines. Capital ratio, cost of equity and carry are illustrative.
_note: Working assumptions agreed in design review (specs/unused_line_management). Regulatory items marked 'assumed' are not current US law. Business items are illustrative and should be replaced by the bank's finance team. Workbook inputs (segment economics, levers, responses) are in workbook_model.json.

bank_profile._bank_category_note: Added in Stage 3: liquidity applies when apply_to = all_banks or the bank is in Categories I-III. The illustrative bank is assumed to be in Categories I-III (as in brief section 2.7). Capital uses 10% / 45% / 75% for every bank either way.

transactor_test._note: Answer 5 (15 Nov 2026). Per account, the 12 cycles before the reporting date.

drawdown_risk.pd_source: Table8 PD 12 Month at the reporting date
drawdown_risk._leq_unassigned_note: Answer 7: assumption-based; not in the reference workbook. Measured as the mean Behavioral CCF (Table9) over open card accounts at the reporting date.

screen._note: System mode (answer 2, 16 Nov 2026): fully loaded card profit with the measured credit cost, the old capital charge replaced by the new one and the new liquidity cost subtracted. Expected drawdown loss is shown beside profit, not deducted (realised drawdown losses already flow into the measured credit cost).
screen._include_expected_drawdown_loss_note: Sensitivity toggle 'Screen including expected drawdown loss' (default off). Workbook-reproduction mode always uses the workbook's own modelled loss.
screen._fraud_proxy_note: Approximate: a Table3 FRAUD_COMPROMISE deactivation in the last 2 cycles (no fraud-block status exists in the data).

segments._source: Workbook Segment Definitions sheet; priority order

relationship._investments_note: Investments are not in the data: deposits only (labelled approximate).

confirmation_signals: card due for reissue within 12 months (Table3)

transactors._note: Segmentation rule (>= 10 of 12), separate from the regulatory transactor test (12 of 12, capital.transactor_months_required).

extra_levers._label: assumption-based; not in the reference workbook

suppress_automatic_increases.eligibility: screened accounts with an automatic (PROACTIVE_INCREASE) line increase in the last 12 months
suppress_automatic_increases.avoided_increase: the same amount again next year (Table20 trailing 12 months)
suppress_automatic_increases.revenue_effect: none assumed (increases on unprofitable low-use lines)

non_reissue_expired_dormant.eligibility: dormant accounts eligible for closure (B6 flag) whose card expires within 12 months, not already closed by the closure lever

system_mode._note: System mode (default). Lever shares, response, attrition, spend loss and PD uplift come from workbook_model.json by scenario and segment; sizing and eligibility below follow the Lever Guide and the brief.
system_mode._decrease_target_note: Lever Guide: idle and sock-drawer lines to about 3-4x peak 12-month balance; transactors to peak plus headroom, at least $5,000; deteriorating to balance + 20%.
system_mode._closure_note: Closures are inactivity closures only (Reg B inactivity exception); the workbook's small sock-drawer and deteriorating closure shares find no eligible account.
system_mode._stress_note: System mode: the multiplier raises attrition, spend loss and PD uplift and divides the response rate. Workbook-reproduction mode scales attrition and spend loss only.
system_mode._headline_note: Headline annual value = change in card profit + reduction in expected drawdown loss (drawdown loss is beside profit in the baseline; its change is the main benefit of a line cut). Both parts are shown.

workbook_reproduction._note: Answer 4: a separate mode that uses the workbook's modelled loss throughout, for the +/-1% test.
workbook_reproduction._corrected_note: Brief section 7 expects about $117.9M RWA with Relationship at 45% (segment-level mapping of the 2023 55% weight); the account-level test in the module decides per account instead.

treatment._note: Stage 6. Recommendations come from the Base scenario's selection. Compliance references are a summary for discussion; to be confirmed by compliance.

notices.CREDIT_DETERIORATION: Reg B adverse action notice within 30 days, with specific reasons or the right to request them (12 CFR 1002.9)
notices.IDLE_LINE_RIGHTSIZING: Reg B adverse action notice within 30 days: a reduction not made in connection with inactivity, default or delinquency (12 CFR 1002.2(c), 1002.9); confirm with compliance
notices.INACTIVITY: No adverse action notice (Reg B inactivity exception, 12 CFR 1002.2(c)(2)(ii)); reason code recorded
notices.OTHER: No notice; offer terms reviewed for UDAAP

treatment.fee_restriction_text: No over-limit fee or penalty rate based on the lower limit until 45 days after notice (Reg Z 1026.9(c)(2)(vi), (g)(4))
treatment.fcra_flag_text: FCRA score disclosure check: a bureau-based score was used in the decision
never_propose: inactivity fee (inactivity penalty fees are prohibited, Reg Z 1026.52(b))

review_together_levers.L3: L3 pricing worklist (e.g. a reprice combined with an engagement offer)
review_together_levers.L5: L5 retention worklist (e.g. a retention target combined with a line cut)

timing._note: Year-1 realisation per lever (config). Line actions need approval but no prior notice; capital and liquidity savings start at the next reporting date.

line_decrease.starts: after approval; capital and liquidity saving from the next reporting date
line_decrease.full_value: immediately after the cut; further reviews add more

risk_based_decrease.starts: after approval; capital and liquidity saving from the next reporting date

suppress_automatic_increases.full_value: as the increases would have happened
